Container.Name: GlanceRiff
Container.Overview: Lightweight glances-style system monitor. Web dashboard and JSON API for CPU, memory, disks, network, temperatures and processes, with history graphs. Optional password or token protection.

Config.Name: Host OS info
Config.Description: Lets the dashboard show the host's OS name instead of the container's.

Config.Name: User shares
Config.Description: Mounted read-only so the disk usage of the user shares shows up.

Config.Name: Username
Config.Description: Login for the web UI. Set together with the password, or leave both empty for no login.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Password for the web UI login.

Config.Name: API token
Config.Description: Lets scripts call the API with 'Authorization: Bearer TOKEN'. Leave empty to disable.
